SOUND_WHOOSH.name: sound-whoosh
SOUND_WHOOSH.comment: The vanilla throw sound. Tick more than one sound to have a random one picked on each yeet.

RANDOMIZE_PITCH.name: randomize-pitch
RANDOMIZE_PITCH.comment: Vary the pitch of the yeet sound by up to 25% either way on each throw. Obvious on clips you recognise.

SERVER_PLAY_GRUNT.name: server-play-grunt
SERVER_PLAY_GRUNT.comment: Play the player's exertion grunt alongside the yeet sound. Server-wide.

SOUND_CHICKEN.name: sound-chicken
SOUND_CHICKEN.comment: A chicken. Picks one of three chicken recordings at random on each yeet.

LOCK_ANGLE.name: lock-45-degree-throws
LOCK_ANGLE.comment: Throw at a fixed 45 degree arc. Turn off to throw wherever you are looking.

VOLUME.name: volume
VOLUME.comment: Yeet sound volume as a percentage. The server can cap this below 100.

SERVER_SOUND_RANGE.name: server-sound-range
SERVER_SOUND_RANGE.comment: Blocks within which a yeet sound can be heard. Server-wide.

SERVER_VOLUME_CEILING.name: server-volume-ceiling
SERVER_VOLUME_CEILING.comment: Ceiling on yeet sound volume, 0-1. Each player's own percentage scales against this, so lowering it turns everyone down without touching their setting.

STRENGTH.name: strength
STRENGTH.comment: How far your yeets go, as a percentage of the maximum distance. 50 is the original throw distance; 25 is half of that.

SERVER_MAX_STRENGTH.name: server-max-strength
SERVER_MAX_STRENGTH.comment: Ceiling on yeet strength for every player, as a percentage of maximum distance. Server-wide.
